## Overview

This script reruns the RNA-seq Hallmark GSEA used for the pan-cancer Hallmark heatmap.

It does not load legacy GSEA result files. Instead, it reads the official RNA-seq DESeq2 age results imported in step 01 and performs Hallmark KS-test enrichment with `hypeR` for each TCGA cancer type.

The saved output is the combined-table representation needed for the final heatmap.

## Libraries

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(tibble)
  library(here)
  library(hypeR)
})
```

## Paths

```{r}
import_file <- here::here(
  "results", "derived", "part1", "01_import_official_results", "part1_imported_results.rds"
)

if (!file.exists(import_file)) {
  stop("Run 01_import_official_results.Rmd first. Missing file: ", import_file)
}

out_dir    <- here::here("results", "derived", "part1", "02_rnaseq_hallmark_gsea")
tables_dir <- here::here("results", "tables", "part1")

dir.create(out_dir,    recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Load imported results

```{r}
part1_imported_results <- readRDS(import_file)

rnaseq_manifest <- part1_imported_results$result_file_manifest %>%
  dplyr::filter(layer_id == "RNAseq", result_use == "unfiltered_deseq") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Project)

if (nrow(rnaseq_manifest) == 0) {
  stop("No RNA-seq unfiltered DESeq2 files were recorded in the imported-results object.")
}
```

## Hallmark gene sets

```{r}
hallmark_sets <- tryCatch(
  {
    hypeR::msigdb_gsets("Homo sapiens", "H", clean = TRUE)
  },
  error = function(e) {
    if (!requireNamespace("msigdbr", quietly = TRUE)) {
      stop(
        "Could not retrieve Hallmark gene sets with hypeR::msigdb_gsets(), ",
        "and package 'msigdbr' is not available for fallback retrieval."
      )
    }

    msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H") %>%
      dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        gs_name = stringr::str_remove(gs_name, "^HALLMARK_"),
        gs_name = stringr::str_replace_all(gs_name, "_", " ")
      ) %>%
      split(.$gene_symbol, .$gs_name)
  }
)
```

## Run per-cancer Hallmark KS-test enrichment

```{r}
gsea_long <- purrr::map_dfr(
  seq_len(nrow(rnaseq_manifest)),
  function(i) {
    project   <- rnaseq_manifest$Project[[i]]
    file_path <- rnaseq_manifest$file_path[[i]]

    deseq_df <- readRDS(file_path) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("Feature") %>%
      dplyr::filter(is.finite(stat))

    ranked_up <- deseq_df %>%
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(stat)) %>%
      dplyr::pull(Feature)

    ranked_down <- deseq_df %>%
      dplyr::arrange(stat) %>%
      dplyr::pull(Feature)

    mhype <- hypeR::hypeR(
      list(
        Upregulated = ranked_up,
        Downregulated = ranked_down
      ),
      genesets = hallmark_sets,
      test = "kstest",
      fdr = 1,
      plotting = FALSE
    )

    up_tbl <- mhype$data$Upregulated$data %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        cancertype = project,
        direction = "Up",
        adjusted_score = score
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(label, cancertype, direction, pval, fdr, score, adjusted_score)

    down_tbl <- mhype$data$Downregulated$data %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        cancertype = project,
        direction = "Down",
        adjusted_score = -score
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(label, cancertype, direction, pval, fdr, score, adjusted_score)

    dplyr::bind_rows(up_tbl, down_tbl)
  }
)
```

## Keep the most significant direction per pathway and cancer

```{r}
gsea_best <- gsea_long %>%
  dplyr::arrange(label, cancertype, pval) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(label, cancertype, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TH_value = dplyr::case_when(
      fdr <= 0.01 & direction == "Up" ~ 2,
      fdr <= 0.05 & direction == "Up" ~ 1,
      fdr <= 0.01 & direction == "Down" ~ -2,
      fdr <= 0.05 & direction == "Down" ~ -1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  )
```

## Combined-table matrices for the Hallmark heatmap

```{r}
pathway_order <- unique(gsea_best$label)
cancer_order <- sort(unique(gsea_best$cancertype))

threshold_df <- gsea_best %>%
  dplyr::select(label, cancertype, TH_value) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    label = pathway_order,
    cancertype = cancer_order,
    fill = list(TH_value = 0)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    label = factor(label, levels = pathway_order),
    cancertype = factor(cancertype, levels = cancer_order)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(label, cancertype) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = cancertype,
    values_from = TH_value
  )

threshold_matrix <- as.matrix(threshold_df[, -1, drop = FALSE])
rownames(threshold_matrix) <- as.character(threshold_df$label)

score_df <- gsea_best %>%
  dplyr::select(label, cancertype, adjusted_score) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    label = pathway_order,
    cancertype = cancer_order,
    fill = list(adjusted_score = 0)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    label = factor(label, levels = pathway_order),
    cancertype = factor(cancertype, levels = cancer_order)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(label, cancertype) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = cancertype,
    values_from = adjusted_score
  )

score_matrix <- as.matrix(score_df[, -1, drop = FALSE])
rownames(score_matrix) <- as.character(score_df$label)

threshold_matrix <- apply(threshold_matrix, 2, as.numeric)
score_matrix     <- apply(score_matrix, 2, as.numeric)
rownames(threshold_matrix) <- as.character(threshold_df$label)
rownames(score_matrix) <- as.character(score_df$label)
```

## Save official GSEA results

```{r}
rnaseq_hallmark_gsea <- list(
  gsea_long = gsea_long,
  gsea_best = gsea_best,
  threshold_matrix = threshold_matrix,
  score_matrix = score_matrix
)

saveRDS(
  rnaseq_hallmark_gsea,
  file.path(out_dir, "rnaseq_hallmark_gsea_results.rds")
)

utils::write.csv(
  gsea_long,
  file = file.path(tables_dir, "fig1c_rnaseq_hallmark_gsea_long.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  gsea_best,
  file = file.path(tables_dir, "fig1c_rnaseq_hallmark_gsea_best.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

dplyr::count(gsea_long, cancertype)

dim(threshold_matrix)
